one_month_reasoning: Re-centred on the verified 2026-10-02 close of $2.375 (Twelve Data), not $2.425. There is no earnings print in the window to 2026-11-01. H1 was reported 2026-09-11, and the FY26 preliminary revenue release usually comes in January. Scheduled or likely items: (1) the QS7001 V1 Common Criteria test report, now targeted for October 2026 after two slips (Aug-14 and Sep-25 6-Ks). Delivery would give a modest positive PR pop that has historically faded, and a third slip would be a clear negative. (2) A possible preliminary Q3 metrics release. (3) SAIQ began trading Oct 2, but its PIPE price-protection date (~Nov 30) falls outside the window. (4) The FOMC on Oct 28 is a macro risk-appetite event; I no longer use the unverified Kalshi aggregator odds. Model: lognormal with ~21% one-month sigma, below the 100%/3.5 rule because realized September ranges were tighter ($2.19-2.61 over 30 sessions), and a ~1% negative drift for burn. I add a little mass above $1.94 because cash per share is now ~$2.00 (~$460M / 231M) and has acted as a floor, and a slightly fatter right tail for quantum-sector beta.

bull.story: A sector-wide quantum/PQC hype cycle (as in Dec-2024 $0.4 to $11 and Oct-2025 $2.6 to $8.7) coincides with certifications and first PQC volume orders. Supply from the 60.8M Class E warrants at $5.50 and the $28.9M ATM caps sustained trading above ~$5.5.

thesis_break_reason: $1.40 x 231M = ~$323M, below my ~$354M projected Oct-2027 net cash before any value for stakes or operations, and ~0.7x today's ~$2.00 cash per share. A trade there would mean the market expects cash to be destroyed (value-destructive SEALQuantum/related-party deals, stake write-downs, faster burn or a dilutive raise) or the PQC roadmap to fail, not ordinary volatility around the cash floor. I lowered it from $1.45 because the larger share count lowers per-share cash.

reasoning: Starting point (verified): the 2026-10-02 close was $2.375, not $2.425. With ~231M economic shares (F shares carry ~5x economics) the market cap is ~$549M against ~$460M cash after Q3 burn and the $10M SAIQ PIPE, so cash per share is ~$2.00 now and EV is ~$90M. Forward: ~$50M/yr operating cash burn (from the cash-flow statement rather than the operating loss) plus ~$60M of SEALQuantum deployment gives ~$354M net cash (~$1.53/share) by Oct-2027, or ~$1.77 with stakes at 50%. Base rates are unchanged in kind: negative or near-zero-EV small caps average positive next-year returns but with heavy skew, and cash burners converge toward lower future cash. LAES's own ~$2 floor in Mar-2025/Apr-2026 was at a higher cash per share than the ~$1.5-1.8 it will be by the horizon, so the floor is drifting down. Two certification slips in six weeks (Aug-14, Sep-25 6-Ks, verified directly) push meaningful PQC revenue into H2-2027, so I cut 2027E revenue to ~$40M. Fair value falls from $2.05 to $1.98, ~17% below spot. The ladder shifts down ~1-2 points through the middle (median ~$2.07), and the far right tail is trimmed (P>=$6.06 5.5%) for warrant/ATM supply. Mean ~$2.45 from the scenarios is roughly flat to spot, reflecting the fat hype tail. I dropped the Kalshi 2027 recession figure: it came from an unverified aggregator, and the bear probability (30%) now rests on the cash-burner base rate and LAES's repeated slips, not on macro odds. Where I differ from the supervisor: its $2.15 fair value uses 3x EV/sales on operations; I keep 1.5x given operating losses of ~3x revenue and repeated slips, so I stay lower. Research this round was ~3 checks (Twelve Data close, Sep-25 6-K direct fetch). I did not consult option data.
